note: Belize: a foreign worker applies to the Labour Department for a Temporary Employment Permit, issued by the Immigration Department once the fee is paid; entertainers have their own permit for one week or less, $600 alone, $1,000 for a group of two to five, $1,500 for six or more (Immigration and Nationality Department). No days of performing without it are named. Nationals of the CSME's participating states work on the CARICOM Skills Certificate instead (the csme list).

sources.title: Belize Immigration and Nationality Department, Temporary Employment Permit
sources.said: The submission of the application is to be done at any Labour Department Office. ... H. Entertainers performing in groups of two or more persons but whose group consists of less than six persons One Week or less $1000.00 I. Entertainers performing in groups of six persons or more One Week or less $1500.00 J. Entertainers performing alone One week or less $600.00
